race.description: Roll The Dice Racing Mdn Plate
race.comment: AKARI SPIRIT (1) missed the start last time when well in the market but found the line nicely last start to get up for third over 1600m at Wagga. Will need to be on his best affair at the jump from that wide gate, but looks well up to winning this. MEHSUN (4) settled well back at the first run back from a break last start and never really threatened when eighth over 1500m at Caulfield Heath. This is a much more suitable assignment and with the blinkers added he is one to watch at the second run back. BELLE FLAMME (8) finished third last time over 1350m at Donald when resuming from a spell, beaten 1.5 lengths. Kept ticking over with a jumpout since, draws well and gets blinkers. ZOVOZO (12) wasn't beaten far last time and only found one better the two prior, so a win is close.
